mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue expectations upward and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 240.0 indicates elevated inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 240.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is above 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 100 signals expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm payrolls exceeding 0.5% indicates strong labor market growth, which typically supports consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 0.5% (m/m), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth combined with housing starts above their 12-month average signals a robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 growth rate is positive (q/q) and HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rising above 0.5% signals the onset of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is above 0.05.
